description: Submit an async job that runs off your context; returns a job_id immediately. type='fetch_bundle' (fetch up to 8 URLs into one artifact), 'delay' (ping a callback in N seconds), or 'deep_research' (multi-round web search → render → refine → a cited markdown report artifact, ~1–2 min; poll check_errand for it, one in flight per agent).
name: submit_errand
